data.title: Padres predicted to re-sign 2.38 ERA reliever and .865 OPS slugger - Sporting News
data.content: # Padres predicted to re-sign 2.38 ERA reliever and .865 OPS slugger. The San Diego Padres were eliminated in the NLDS by the Milwaukee Brewers after four games, and now look ahead to the 2026-2027 MLB offseason with some big decisions to make. With a lot of the focus on the starting rotation, and for good reason, it's important for the Padres to not forget about ensuring their bullpen stays strong, and their lineup doesn't miss a beat. That's why the prediction from ESPN's Alden Gonzalez, where the Padres re-sign 2.38 ERA reliever Adrian Morejon and .865 OPS slugger Ty France, would be such a dream-come-true scenario for the Padres this offseason. ## Padres predicted to re-sign Ty France, Adrian Morejon. "The Padres find a way to bring Morejon back, pairing him with Mason Miller in the back end of their bullpen to continue to shut down games," Gonzalez predicts. Morejon, while not the Padres' closer, is maybe MLB's best No. 2 reliever in baseball.
